007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Tool;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.EmailNotificationToolParams;
014import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.RagToolParams;
015import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.SlackNotificationToolParams;
016import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.SqlToolParams;
017import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolAttributes;
018import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolInput;
019import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolParams;
020import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.WebSearchToolParams;
021
022/**
023 * Loads an existing agent tool and reads its current metadata and attributes.
024 *
025 * <p>Set {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}, {@code SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD},
026 * {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}, and {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_NAME}. The named
027 * tool must already exist and be visible to the connected user. See
028 * {@code samples/README.md} for build and run commands.</p>
029 *
030 * <p>Known built-in parameters are read through their typed getters. Unknown
031 * parameter models are inspected through {@link ToolParams#toMap()} without
032 * printing arbitrary values, which may contain sensitive configuration.</p>
033 * <p>Input metadata is returned as immutable {@link ToolInput} entries. This
034 * sample prints names and whether descriptions are present, not their text.</p>
035 * <p>Instructions and custom-function configuration are inspected without
036 * printing their values. The raw tool type is shown only for types introduced
037 * by a database release that this SDK does not recognize.</p>
038 *
039 * @see CreateToolWithInputsSample
040 * @see SetToolInputsSample
041 */
042public final class LoadToolSample {
043
044    private LoadToolSample() {
045    }
046
047    /**
048     * Loads tool metadata and inspects its typed parameters.
049     *
050     * @param args unused command-line arguments
051     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails; the process exits unsuccessfully
052     */
053    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
054        String toolName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_NAME");
055        try (SelectAIAgent client = createClient()) {
056            Tool tool = client.tool(toolName);
057            System.out.printf("Tool: %s%n", tool.getToolName());
058            System.out.printf("Status: %s%n", tool.getStatus());
059            System.out.printf("Description: %s%n", tool.getDescription());
060            ToolAttributes attributes = tool.getToolAttributes();
061            System.out.printf("Tool type: %s%n", attributes.getToolType());
062            if (attributes.getToolType() != null && !attributes.getToolType().isKnown()) {
063                System.out.printf("Database-defined tool type: %s%n", attributes.getToolTypeValue());
064            }
065            System.out.printf("Instruction configured: %s%n", attributes.getInstruction() != null);
066            System.out.printf("Custom function configured: %s%n", attributes.getFunction() != null);
067            printParams(attributes.getToolParams());
068            if (attributes.getToolInputs() == null) {
069                System.out.println("Tool inputs: not configured");
070            } else {
071                System.out.printf("Tool inputs: %d%n", attributes.getToolInputs().size());
072                for (ToolInput input : attributes.getToolInputs()) {
073                    System.out.printf("Input: %s; description configured: %s%n",
074                            input.getName(), input.getDescription() != null);
075                }
076            }
077        }
078    }
079
080    private static void printParams(ToolParams params) {
081        if (params == null) {
082            System.out.println("Tool parameters: not configured");
083        } else if (params instanceof SqlToolParams sql) {
084            System.out.printf("SQL profile: %s%n", sql.getProfileName());
085        } else if (params instanceof RagToolParams rag) {
086            System.out.printf("RAG profile: %s%n", rag.getProfileName());
087        } else if (params instanceof WebSearchToolParams webSearch) {
088            System.out.printf("Web-search credential: %s%n", webSearch.getCredentialName());
089        } else if (params instanceof SlackNotificationToolParams slack) {
090            System.out.printf("Notification type: %s; channel configured: %s%n",
091                    slack.getNotificationType(), slack.getChannel() != null);
092        } else if (params instanceof EmailNotificationToolParams email) {
093            System.out.printf("Notification type: %s; recipient configured: %s%n",
094                    email.getNotificationType(), email.getRecipient() != null);
095        } else {
096            System.out.printf("Database-defined parameter names: %s%n", params.toMap().keySet());
097        }
098    }
099
100    private static SelectAIAgent createClient() throws SelectAIException {
101        return SelectAIAgent.create(DbConnectionConfig.builder()
102                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
103                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
104                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
105                .build());
106    }
107
108    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
109        String value = System.getenv(name);
110        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
111            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
112        }
113        return value;
114    }
115}
